title: Law to let commercial tenants recover attorneys' fees too
summary: This bill would require that when a commercial lease lets landlords recover attorneys' fees from a tenant in default, tenants can likewise recover attorneys' fees when a landlord defaults or when the tenant successfully defends a landlord's lawsuit. Tenants could claim these fees either by filing their own case or as a counterclaim. The law would apply to leases entered into or renewed after it takes effect and any waiver of this right would be void.
